scope: Existing-record audit against all 244 captured official posting references
method: Compared posting URLs with public/jobs.json and checked captured detail text for existing deadlines and closure states. Individually reviewed discrepancies before changing records.

correctedRecords.finding: Interfolio states the Oct 9, 2026 application deadline has passed and directs candidates to contact the institution. Marked closed as of Oct 9.
Interfolio says review began Sep 15, 2026 and materials are due Jan 31, 2027; the stored deadline was incorrectly Feb 7. Corrected.
Seven UC Recruit records lacked a structured final application date. Added exact final dates and kept the post-review, only-if-unfilled condition in summaries.
The capture inventory used older URL variants; existing records now point to current canonical requisitions.

Full PeopleAdmin detail pages say sponsorship is unavailable for the older clinical faculty and postdoc (their records incorrectly said yes; corrected to no), and uncertain for the new 2027 TT and clinical roles (recorded as case-by-case).

limitations: All captured pages received first-pass keyword triage; this does not complete the 137 school rows still marked partial.
